observations: Every winning uk4 candidate reduces dynamic K-loop trip count by 50-75% relative to uk1.
Spill count at the measured winner ranges 0-18 with no observed case severe enough to flip ranking.
Smallest tested problem (smallA, 4096 FLOPs) still favored uk4 despite 10/11 spills/reloads -- fixed overhead did not dominate at this scale, contrary to the a priori hypothesis.
Highest K-trip-count domain (highK, trip 16) was completely spill-free and had the cleanest static-model agreement.
no_regression_model_fit: Explicitly not attempted at n=6 domains, per task instruction against overfitting.
